notes: No build, no dependencies, no backend: a fresh worktree needs no setup (npm test runs Node's built-in test runner; Node 22+). The app is one page; Today / Nutrition / Workouts / Progress are tabs addressed by the URL hash (#today, #nutrition, #workouts, #progress). The Data & backup sheet opens from the header button (export/import JSON). All data lives in the browser's IndexedDB database 'genki', so a browser test starts from an empty profile; a different port is a different origin with its own data. The service worker registers only over https, so it never runs on localhost. CI is the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml): it runs both stacks on every PR and on main before deploying. Public repo: never put real personal data in fixtures or tests. Nutrition: the profile sheet (Nutrition tab, 'Profile & targets') sets the calorie and protein targets; the add-food sheet fetches foods/jp.json and foods/us.json on first open. A browser test needs a made-up profile before targets show. Weigh-ins: the Today tab's weight card (Log weight, History, Import CSV of date,weight_kg rows; the import uses a confirm() dialog). Weigh-ins move the profile's weight to the 7-day average. Workouts: the Workouts tab has Train / Progress / Plan toggles; a fresh origin opens on Plan ('Use this plan' saves one). A session in progress is saved on every keystroke (meta liftDraft). Liftlog import offer appears when localStorage 'liftlog.v1' holds Liftlog data (set it with made-up sessions to test); Discard and Delete use confirm() dialogs. Progress: read-only week views (Overview / Calories / Macros / Nutrients / Weight) of the food log and weigh-ins; Export week (CSV) downloads genki-week-<monday>.csv. Day trackers (Today tab): Fasting card (Plan sheet, Start/End fast with a live timer, History with edit/add/delete; End before the goal uses confirm()), Water card (- / + glasses, goal sheet), Exercise card (calories, steps, net calories; the Nutrition tab shows the same line). Stores 'days' and 'fasts' (DB version 8). Coach cards (Today tab, under Log food): a Today card (a sentence on today against the targets, up to three meal ideas from my foods / my meals with a + that logs one) and a This week card (biggest win, protein target days, calories / protein / weight against last week); read-only apart from the + (needs a profile and my foods or my meals to show ideas). Barcode scan and voice search (add sheet's Scan button and the mic beside the search box; My foods has Scan barcode): headless browsers have no camera, so test with 'Take a photo instead' (a PNG of a made-up barcode) or the typed number. Always mock https://world.openfoodfacts.org/** with page.route in browser tests; never hit it with real or made-up codes from CI.
